issue.title: port_alias.py returns empty sysports list due to port_config.ini header change

failure.body:
### Issue Description

In https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/18704 the header of port_config.ini was changed to include underscores in some header names:
coreId -> core_id
corePortId -> core_port_id
numVoq -> num_voq

But the port_alias.py file depends on the header names and it wasn't updated appropriately:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/library/port_alias.py#L146
```
                        if 'coreid' in text:
                            port_coreid_index = index
                        if 'coreportid' in text:
                            port_core_portid_index = index
                        if 'numvoq' in text:
                            num_voq_index = index
```

### Results you see

This results in the `deploy-mg` providing a minigraph.xml with an empty SystemPort section:
```
<SystemPorts>
</SystemPorts>
```

### Results you expected to see

The SystemPorts should be populated, e.g.:
```
<SystemPorts>
  <SystemPort>
    <Name>Cpu0</Name>
    <Hostname>nfc407-5</Hostname>
    <AsicName>Asic0</AsicName>
    <Speed>10000</Speed>
    <SystemPortId>0</SystemPortId>
    <SwitchId>0</SwitchId>
    <CoreId>0</CoreId>
    <CorePortId>0</CorePortId>
    <NumVoq>8</NumVoq>
  </SystemPort>
```

### Is it platform specific

generic

resolution.title: port_alias.py: Handle port_config.ini header change
resolution.description:
In https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/18704 the header of port_config.ini was changed:
```
- # name              lanes     alias               index  role   speed    asic_port_name     coreId     corePortId     numVoq
+ # name              lanes     alias               index  role   speed    asic_port_name     core_id     core_port_id     num_voq
```

But port_alias.py depends on the header names and wasn't updated:
```
ALLOWED_HEADER = ['name', 'lanes', 'alias', 'index', 'asic_port_name', 'role', 'speed',
                  'coreid', 'coreportid', 'numvoq']
```

This PR updates port_alias.py to account for the port_config.ini change.

Summary:
Fixes #12718

### Type of change
[x] Bug fix
